name: Access review
description: Review privileged access to systems that hold regulated information and remove access that is no longer needed

name: Retention review
description: Review records that have passed their retention period and approve their disposal

name: Log review
description: Review audit logs and security logs for regulated systems and record the outcome of the review

name: Incident classification and reporting
description: Classify security incidents and report incidents that affect regulated information to the regulator

name: Consent register check
description: Check that consent records exist for processing beyond the original service

name: Third-party risk assessment
description: Assess the security of each third party before personal data is shared and once a year after that

name: Deletion request tracking
description: Track personal-data deletion requests to completion within thirty days
